title: config
summary: Show or change settings: editor, copy bank folder, history file.
notes: With no arguments it prints the current settings.
The copy bank is a **folder**. CWM keeps a second `cwm.db` inside it and merges both ways. If you pass a `.db` file path, CWM uses its folder.
Do not point two PCs at a folder that a sync service (OneDrive, Dropbox) copies while CWM writes. SQLite files can be damaged by that.
Unknown keys are an error. They are not stored silently.

flags.name: --editor <app>
flags.desc: Editor for `save -s`. For example `nano`, `notepad`, `"code --wait"`. Use `--editor clear` to reset.

flags.name: --change-history-file <path>
flags.desc: Use this file as your shell history. The name must contain `history`.

examples.title: Show settings
examples.output:
Configuration Source
  Path: C:\Users\you\.cwm\cwm.db

General Settings
  History File:     Auto-Detect
  Preferred Editor: Auto-Detect (OS default)
  Copy Bank Path:   Not Configured

examples.title: Unknown key
examples.output: Unknown setting 'nokey'. Use: cwm config editor <name>, or the flags --editor, -c/--copy-bank, --change-history-file, --clear.
